column1: # S0 map (Lean theorem statements vs HOL4 kernel export). Tab separated; lines starting with # are comments.
# Derived only from CONVENTIONS.md and the two naming systems. status=fitted marks rows added or changed after looking at base statements.
# kind=CONST: hol4 constant | Lean names that count as it (comma list) | perm | status | note.
#   perm: HOL4 argument j is Lean explicit argument perm[j] (empty = same order). Names starting with @ are rules implemented in scan.py.
# kind=TYPE: HOL4 type constructor | Lean names. kind=UNFOLD: Lean definition that CONVENTIONS defines as an abbreviation; scan.py unfolds it.
# Every other Lean definition marked @[reducible] is unfolded too, unless it is a Lean name listed in a CONST row (I, K, UNCURRY, PAIR_MAP).
# kind=ALLOW: Lean constant that is allowed to be opaque (HOL4 unspecified value). kind=RULE: normalisation rule, documentation of scan.py.

Lean theorem name = HOL4 name in namespace Candle or HOL; suffix _thm when the plain name is a constant (needed for RACONV and REV_ASSOCD)

HOL4 free variables of a statement are implicitly universal: they join the leading universal block. A run of consecutive universal (or existential) binders is order-insensitive: binders are renamed by first occurrence in the body.
A /\ B ==> C, A ==> B ==> C and Lean A /\ B -> C, A -> B -> C are identified (premises are flattened into an ordered list); a Lean pi with Prop domain is an implication.
Nested /\ and nested \/ chains are flattened. Lean Iff and Eq on Prop and HOL4 = on bool are the same node. Lean Ne a b is Not (a = b).
HOL4 NUMERAL (BIT1/BIT2/ZERO) and num$0, Lean OfNat.ofNat n literals and raw numerals become one number node; SUC n becomes n + 1.
list$NIL at type char list, Lean List.nil at char, HOL.str "..." and a CONS chain of character literals become one string node; CHR n, HOL.ch c and Char.ofNat n become one character node.
UNCURRY f p is rewritten to f (FST p) (SND p) on both sides (beta reduced); a Lean matcher (.match_N) with one alternative on a pair is the same.
Lean setOf P is GSPEC (fun x => (x, P x)).

Instance-implicit arguments and instance binders are ignored in the structural comparison. Instance binders are compared as a set of classes with the classes needed by the Lean constants that the HOL4 constants map to (the instance binders of their Lean types).

Lean type-variable binders (Sort-typed) are skipped. Type variables are renamed by first occurrence in the binder types. Lean reducible abbreviations (thy, sig, tyval, string, word8, ...) are unfolded. Type annotations of non-binder terms (implicit type arguments) are NOT compared.

HOL4 MEM x l is IN x (LIST_TO_SET l) in the export (no MEM constant); it is identified with Lean x in l (List.instMembership). Needed for 100+ statements; found by reading the export, not stated in CONVENTIONS.

combin$o f g x is rewritten to f (g x) on both sides (definition of o). Needed because HOL4 tmsof thy = (SND o FST) thy while Lean thy_tmsof is reducible to thy.1.2 (CONVENTIONS section 4 states the overload but not this rewrite).
Eta: (fun x => f x) is f when x is not free in f. Needed for plus_0_I, where HOL4 has the partial application (+ 0) and Lean a lambda.
HOL4 option_CASE / ordering_CASE and Lean matchers with several alternatives become a case node; zero-parameter alternatives lose their Unit lambda.

Lean matcher alternatives are put in constructor order (read from the casesOn in the matcher body, dumped as altctors) because Lean lists alternatives in source order. Needed for term_union_thm (source order EQUAL, LESS, GREATER).

Type variables are renamed independently inside each conjunct (HOL4 generalises each clause of a definition separately, Lean shares one set). Needed for REV_ASSOCD. Cost: type-variable identity across conjuncts is not compared.
